metadata.title: Evori Font Display with Bird Illustration

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist, flat-design illustration featuring a large, bold, condensed sans-serif typeface spelling 'EVORI' in cream, set against a solid reddish-orange background. A small, stylized black and orange bird with a white eye is perched atop the 'O' of the typeface, looking towards the right.
coreVisualRelationships: The large cream text 'EVORI' dominates the lower half of the composition, serving as the primary subject.
A small, stylized bird is positioned directly on top of the 'O' in 'EVORI', creating a playful interaction.
The solid reddish-orange background provides a strong, contrasting canvas for the cream text and the bird.
The small, condensed text in the top left and top right corners provides contextual information without detracting from the main visual elements.
coreInvariants: The main text 'EVORI' must be rendered in a bold, condensed, sans-serif typeface.
The bird must be a small, stylized, flat-design illustration, primarily black and orange, with a distinct white eye.
The bird must be positioned on top of one of the letters of the main text, creating a sense of interaction.
The background must be a solid, vibrant color that contrasts strongly with the main text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main text 'EVORI' occupies approximately 60-70% of the vertical space in the lower half of the image, making it the dominant element. The bird is significantly smaller, positioned centrally on the 'O', acting as an accent.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, cream-colored 'EVORI' text serves as the primary visual anchor due to its size, contrast, and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is initially drawn to the large 'EVORI' text. The bird, perched on the 'O' and looking right, subtly guides the eye towards the right side of the composition. The small text elements in the corners provide secondary points of interest.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The reddish-orange background functions as significant negative space, particularly in the upper half, allowing the main elements to stand out clearly and creating a clean, uncluttered aesthetic.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: The reddish-orange background is the dominant color, providing warmth and energy.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: The cream color of the 'EVORI' text provides strong contrast against the background, ensuring high readability and visual impact.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: The black and orange of the bird, along with the small white eye, serve as accent colors, adding detail and a focal point without overwhelming the main elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The dominant reddish-orange is highly saturated and mid-value. The cream is a high-value, low-saturation color. The black and orange of the bird are also highly saturated, creating a vibrant yet balanced palette.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to 3-4 main colors for a clean, flat aesthetic.
High contrast between background and primary text is essential.

adjustableVariables: The specific typeface used for 'EVORI' (must remain bold, condensed, sans-serif).
The exact shade of reddish-orange for the background.
The exact shade of cream for the text.
The design and color of the bird (must remain stylized and flat, predominantly black and orange).
The letter on which the bird is perched.
The content of the small text in the corners.
mustRedesign: The bird must be simplified to a flat, geometric shape.
The main text must be a bold, condensed, sans-serif font.
The overall composition must maintain a minimalist and clean aesthetic.

mustAchieve: Clear legibility of the main text.
A strong visual hierarchy with the text as the primary focus.
A playful and engaging interaction between the bird and the text.
A clean, modern, and uncluttered design.
avoid: Overly complex or realistic illustrations for the bird.
Clashing colors or low contrast that hinders readability.
Fonts that are not bold, condensed, or sans-serif for the main text.

postGenerationChecks: Is the 'EVORI' text clearly readable and prominent?
Does the bird illustration maintain its stylized, flat appearance?
Is there sufficient contrast between the text and the background?
Does the overall composition feel balanced and uncluttered?
Is the bird positioned interactively with the text?
Are the colors vibrant and complementary?
recipe.reuseFormula: Render a bold, condensed, sans-serif word in a high-contrast color against a solid, saturated background. Place a small, flat-design, black and orange bird illustration on top of one of the letters, ensuring the bird's eye creates a subtle directional gaze. Add minimal, small-scale text in the upper corners for context.

preserve: softly rounded corners for display text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the bold, condensed, all-caps display aesthetic with strong presence.
Offers a similar tall, condensed, geometric sans-serif feel suitable for display and metadata.
Provides a very bold, condensed, and impactful geometric sans-serif option.
A versatile condensed sans-serif that can be used for both display and smaller text with appropriate weight selection.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid, warm reddish-orange background. Place a stylized, flat-design bird illustration in black and yellow, with a white eye, centered horizontally above the lower third of the canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the main display text in a very large, extra-bold, condensed geometric sans-serif font, all-caps, in an off-white color, centered horizontally at the bottom of the canvas. Overlay the metadata text in a smaller, bold, condensed geometric sans-serif font, all-caps, in off-white, aligned to the top-left. Overlay the logo-like text in a small, bold, condensed geometric sans-serif font, all-caps, in off-white, aligned to the top-right.

verificationChecks: Ensure the main display text is significantly larger and bolder than other text elements.
Verify that all text is in all-caps.
Confirm the main display text has softly rounded corners, while smaller text has sharp corners.
Check that the color of all text is a consistent off-white against the reddish-orange background.
